Equipment.Name: Equalizer Hammer
Equipment.Comments: Noncrit bonus pushes effective PAtk to 371. Might be a bit much... but you give up defense and your crits are meh. I wonder if this is appealing...?

Equipment.Name: Shinigami-no-yokan
Equipment.Comments:
"Premonition of the Reaper". Or so it was translated elsewhere. Hm.
Frankly, stupidly strong by virtue of passive Armor Down access. Comparatively lower PAtk and lack of AP Bonus hopefully make it a slightly more technical weapon, however.

Equipment.Name: Squire of Avalon
Equipment.Description: Reminiscent of someone... and when you hold it into light just right, it looks like fire is raining onto the blade.

Equipment.Name: Sequoian Barrier
Equipment.Description: You don't remember the Sequoia emblem being so large...

Equipment.Name: Twilight's Edge
Equipment.Comments: Weapon inspired by Aer.
Equipment.Description: Its blade shines luminous in daylight, yet turns dark as dusk itself at night...

Equipment.Name: Facetsplitter
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Brickey.
Equipment.Description: In its blade, you see impossible reflections, abilities you never thought you had...

Equipment.Name: Bookbeater
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by ProfessorSMASH.
Equipment.Description: Not what they meant when they told you to "hit the books."

Equipment.Name: Spear of Io
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by iosefe.
Equipment.Description: Occasionally whispers about what you need, when you need it...

Equipment.Name: Ad Infinitum
Equipment.Comments:
Free permanent Refresh is STUPIDLY strong, so this just doesn't get good stats until further notice.
I haven't even released the mod and I already regret making this monstrosity.
Send help. The end has come.

Equipment.Name: Hihiirokane
Equipment.Comments:
Flavor: No real-life equivalent, named after legendary metal instead. The sprite reminded me a little of the shichishito, though.
Kind of borders on low T4, but eeeehh... not super sure.

Equipment.Name: Depth-seer's Tome
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Rafidur.
Equipment.Description: A tome of potential, penned by one who has seen beyond the veil of our perception.

Equipment.Name: Codex Consiliarii
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Z`.
Equipment.Description: Also dubbed "The Wizard's Omnivore", this book seems to literally swell with knowledge to share with all who need it.

Equipment.Name: Loyalty
Equipment.Comments:
This sword is friendshaped.
Reduced PAtk to make up for the fact that it element-boosts itself.
Might be nice for the swordier among Nomads?
Equipment.Description: A simple ideal, forged from frozen wings.

Equipment.Name: Unbound's Scythe
Equipment.Comments: This scythe is friendshaped.
Equipment.Description: Oddly enough, it smells like candy.

Equipment.Name: Butterfly Shortspear
Equipment.Comments: One-handed spears have around 60% of their two-handed brethren's PDef, and around 85% of their PAtk. I might have to nerf PAtk in the long run, though, because even 60% of a Spear's PDef is pretty chunky when you retain access to shields...

Equipment.Name: Royal Dominance
Equipment.Comments: PAtk further reduced because frankly, this is already an unreasonably good defensive weapon.

Equipment.Name: Moonchill
Equipment.Description: For some reason, this seems... familiar.

Equipment.Name: Concealable Knife
Equipment.Comments: Basically an upgrade to the Gouger, or so I hope.

Equipment.Name: Desert Sickle
Equipment.Comments: Note that given River's concern about PPen on full-sized Scythes, I absolutely MUSTN'T create more than one of these per tier. Who knows what Ninjas might do...?

Equipment.Name: Grand Emerald
Equipment.Comments:
Simple, raw, overwhelming force. 
Hilariously high PAtk to make up for lack of special mods like Ragebringer's and Decapitator's.
Still weaker than Muramasa with the Two-Handed Passive... before Variance, anyway.

Equipment.Name: Executioner
Equipment.Comments: Slightly weaker than other T4 Axes, but enhances Mind. Hopefully vaguely relevant to Shaman without being entirely useless to non-casters?

Equipment.Name: Guardian of Tharsis
Equipment.Comments: Unrequested, but referencing ZarroTsu, creator of the EO4 Classes mod.
Equipment.Description: Worthy of a leader on the battlefield; unparalleled in swiftness.

Equipment.Name: Hoplite's Shield
Equipment.Comments: Specifically serves to enable, well, hoplite builds.

Equipment.Name: Warding Glory
Equipment.Comments: Intended to be the counterpart to the Hoplite's Shield, though obviously their mutual equip type enable is rendered at least half-wasted in the process. That said, a bit of MDef is nice too.

Equipment.Name: Fanged Nunchaku
Equipment.Comments:
Nunchaku get truly hideous PAtk stats, but always come with recoil damage. Is it worth it? That's for you to decide.
...I guess a Hemoring will cancel that, but even then, it should be a weighty choice.

Equipment.Name: Kaiser Blade
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Kaiezer.
Equipment.Description: For some reason, just holding this weapon makes your backpack feel extremely full. How odd.

Equipment.Name: Sacrificial Ring
Equipment.Comments: Placed early to encourage some risk-taking early on.

Equipment.Name: Trailblazer's Coat
Equipment.Comments: Instant spells can be stupidly strong, but I'm not sure if the MP penalty isn't a tad *too* harsh...

Equipment.Name: The Mage in Yellow
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Yellow Mage Marsail
Equipment.Description: Smells of ocean salt. Throws impossible shadows. Feels dangerous... could drive you mad?

Equipment.Name: Hoarfrost Buckler
Equipment.Comments: Low PDef because other stats and lack of negative Evasion.

Equipment.Name: Soulfrost Gauntlet
Equipment.Comments: Intended as a Nomad offense item, but up to 30 Atk and 40 Def is nothing to sneeze at, so it's good on everyone, kind of. Also probably busted with my own classes, but whatever.

Equipment.Name: Sawn-off Rifle
Equipment.Description: ...but why?

Equipment.Name: Stick
Equipment.Description: Great for seagull chasing; possibly better than bacon.

Equipment.Name: Les Condamnes
Equipment.Comments: "The Doomed." (There's supposed to be an accent on the E.)

Equipment.Name: Kingshammer
Equipment.Comments: Lower PAtk because it has extra HP on it, and because it's a hammer (gotta factor in the non crit damage).

Equipment.Name: Divine Ruler's Helmet
Equipment.Comments:
Fierce Stance is extremely strong but I still want a form of player access. This one comes with disincentivizing other stances, since you have no way of ever getting back into Fierce, which... may work?
Definitely tailored to Samurai, but I expect vaguely issues with stupidly sturdy Reapers...

Equipment.Name: Woodcarved Goose
Equipment.Description: Or is it some other bird...?

Equipment.Name: Divine Ruler's Plate
Equipment.Comments:
Intended to be tailored to Samurai and utilize its relative hardiness - rather than letting the Samurai sit idle for chunks of the fight, this'll promote its potential to actually soak up damage.
...At least on paper. Inbefore nobody cares to use this.

Equipment.Name: Alloy Helm
Equipment.Comments: A friendly reminder that Warlocks can wear Heavy equipment.

Equipment.Name: Wavelord's Regalia
Equipment.Comments: Intended to supplement Warlock/Nomad in vanilla.

Equipment.Name: Nomad's Bandana
Equipment.Comments: This one's for (offensive) caster Nomads. Why does this patch have so much Nomad gear? ...Good question.

Equipment.Name: Bruiser's Cleaver
Equipment.Comments: Intended to promote Warrior offense a bit.

Equipment.Name: Galebound Tome
Equipment.Comments: Intended as a defensive alternative to the Wind Thresher. ElementDmg modifiers shifted upwards to make up for losing a chunky 37 MPen.

Equipment.Name: Kamihime
Equipment.Comments: Possible enabler for katana Nomad and Samurai/Dervish.
Equipment.Description: An ancient legend. A war predating mankind. A blade of jade and steel.

Equipment.Name: Silent Judge
Equipment.Description: Where there is chaos, can a simple distinction between black and white be made?

Equipment.Name: Faded Colour
Equipment.Description: The violence of aberrant colours, fading into grey. Reveal the truth, or create another.

Equipment.Name: The Second Warning
Equipment.Description: May you find your book, esteemed patron, for this one heralds the end.

Equipment.Name: The Wolf
Equipment.Description: "...you can run but you can't hide, I'm gonna make you mine..."

Equipment.Name: Stonechill
Equipment.Description: Puts a spring in your step and a groove in your moves, yet bears powerful necrotic magic. Just what is this?

Equipment.Name: 0 - Fool
Equipment.Description: A journey's beginning. An impulse, a spark.

Equipment.Name: I - Magician
Equipment.Description: An actor without thought. A blind plunge into the first step.

Equipment.Name: II - High Priestess
Equipment.Description: Inner wisdom, outer knowledge and the clarity of the truth between.

Equipment.Name: III - Empress
Equipment.Description: A caring authority. Strong for others, yet bleeding from wounds unseen.

Equipment.Name: IV - Emperor
Equipment.Description: A bastion in the face of doubt. Control and courage intertwine, laying out a straight path ahead.

Equipment.Name: V - Hierophant
Equipment.Description: Interpreter of fate. Keeper of knowledge.

Equipment.Name: VI - Lovers
Equipment.Description: A split pathway. An unclear choice twixt hardship and harmony.

Equipment.Name: VII - Chariot
Equipment.Description: A determined charge. An unhindered conquest.

Equipment.Name: VIII - Justice
Equipment.Description: A seeker of certainty. An arbiter of order.

Equipment.Name: IX - Hermit
Equipment.Description: More true than a mirror. Mistaken for a castaway.

Equipment.Name: X - Fortune
Equipment.Description: Circumstance and opportunity - the sides of fortune's coin.

Equipment.Name: XI - Strength
Equipment.Description: A virtuous balance. Power with reason.

Equipment.Name: XII - Hanged Man
Equipment.Description: An eternal paradox. A binding that grants true freedom.

Equipment.Name: XIII - Death
Equipment.Description: A death in spirit, not body. A transition, a metamorphosis, a cycle's end and beginning.

Equipment.Name: XIV - Temperance
Equipment.Description: Harmony through synthesis.

Equipment.Name: XV - Devil
Equipment.Description: A pact's commitment. A tempting urge.

Equipment.Name: XVI - Tower
Equipment.Description: A symbol of ephemerality, demise and the responsibility both bear.

Equipment.Name: XVII - Star
Equipment.Description: A brief shimmer. Hopeful, warm light, though destined to disappear.

Equipment.Name: XVIII - Moon
Equipment.Description: A fearful illusion. A fantastic dream. A sly trick of the mind.

Equipment.Name: XIX - Sun
Equipment.Description: A joyful radiance. An endless exuberance.

Equipment.Name: XX - Judgement
Equipment.Description: A determined purpose. A guiding star.

Equipment.Name: XXI - World
Equipment.Description: An ultimate victory. A fulfilled journey.

Equipment.Name: Quintar Pheromones
Equipment.Description: At least that's what you hope this is.

Equipment.Name: Silenced Screams
Equipment.Description: Scream all you like - your gods can't hear you...

Equipment.Name: Leviathan Plate
Equipment.Flavor: Plate of Whale + Bone Mail + Scale Mail
Equipment.Description: Terrifyingly powerful.

Equipment.Name: Squirrel Champion
Equipment.Description: You don't know where, but it procured boxing gloves. It also decided to live under your hat or hat-equivalent.

Equipment.Name: Jadeforged Ring
Equipment.Flavor: Jade Hourglass + Poison Talon + Torpid Cuffs.

Equipment.Name: Flood Pendant
Equipment.Flavor: Snow Pendant + Water Bangle... oh gods.

Equipment.Name: Circle of Ruin
Equipment.Flavor: Snow Pendant + Earth Bangle... oh gods.

Equipment.Name: Ring of Wizardry
Equipment.Flavor: Gem + Mana + Caster's Ring. Possibly a mistake.

Equipment.Name: Warding Beads
Equipment.Flavor: Shell Amulet + Protect Amulet + Beads of Defense

Equipment.Name: Itemmaster's Earrings
Equipment.Flavor: Spring's and Autumn's Oaths, Looter's Pin, Knicked Knackers, Looter's Ring, Loot Finder AND Mugger's Glove. Oof
Equipment.Description: *Actually* overpowered.

Equipment.Name: False Hero's Guise
Equipment.Comments: Threat reduction serves to avoid tanks getting too many benefits out of this. I'm unsure if this doesn't enable DPS too hard, though...

Equipment.Name: Aranea
Equipment.Flavor: 2x Hemoring + 2x Ogre Balls. Eliminates four very strong accessories for one... *very* very strong accessory.

Equipment.Name: Red Helmet
Equipment.Flavor: Red Cap + Red Hat + Spore Blocker + Smelly Gi

Equipment.Name: Redder Coat
Equipment.Description: Or so you were told. This doesn't *look* different, though...

Equipment.Name: Slimy Crown
Equipment.Description: Did you know slimes had electrocytes, like eels?

Equipment.Name: Temporal Robe
Equipment.Description: To be beyond time, one must first be beyond its grasp.

Equipment.Name: Sky Puncture
Equipment.Description: Puncture the sky, shatter the clouds, bring the storm.

Equipment.Name: Superspeed Bow
Equipment.Description: Gotta go fast! And shoot fast! And be fast! And fast fast! No, not that last one.

Equipment.Name: Rapier of Warning
Equipment.Description: Float like an axe beak, sting like a... sting jelly?

Equipment.Name: Storm Spear
Equipment.Description: Lightning, lightning, very, very fright'ning,...

Equipment.Name: Echo Chamber
Equipment.Description: ECHO! Echo! Echo.. Echo... cho... ...

Equipment.Name: Magic Barrier
Equipment.Description: But does it block magic or enhance magic? Yes, actually.

Equipment.Name: Robust Shield
Equipment.Description: So robust, it'll still be in one piece even after you've been obliterated by divine flame!

Equipment.Name: Limiter Shield
Equipment.Description: "Two things are infinite." Neither of them is your power.

Equipment.Name: Caduceus
Equipment.Description: "Watch this work with like none of the overhauls!" -Anonymous

Equipment.Name: Feathered Vest
Equipment.Description: Fluffy!

Equipment.Name: Frost Plate
Equipment.Description: Chill! You might blow a fuse!

Equipment.Name: Pincer Spear
Equipment.Description: You're not sure whether to dread the creature this pincer came from... or the madman who stuck it on a pointy pole.

Equipment.Name: Demon Scythe
Equipment.Description: Blood for blood, soul for soul, but your sins are yours alone.

Equipment.Name: Earth Staff
Equipment.Description: You'd think it's connected to the earth somehow, but no, it just smells like soil.

Equipment.Name: Wailing Staff
Equipment.Description: Guaranteed to be the noisiest weapon in your arsenal.

Equipment.Name: Harpy Rod
Equipment.Description: Doesn't abduct people, but still channels storms.

Equipment.Name: Breach Wand
Equipment.Description: Breaches shields, barriers, wards, and sometimes skulls if you try hard enough.

Equipment.Name: Shroomling Suit
Equipment.Description: Causes intense sneezing fits in the wearer and anyone else nearby.

Equipment.Name: Poison Coat
Equipment.Description: A coat by any other name wouldn't be half as hazardous.

Equipment.Name: Trench Coat
Equipment.Description: No trenches are dug here, but maybe you can pretend to be Herlock Sholmes or something.

Equipment.Name: Nan's Robe
Equipment.Description: You don't want to know where the Nan this belongs to is...

Equipment.Name: Protective Goggles
Equipment.Description: Do not question how protective they are of the rest of your body. Just take the Poison immunity and be at peace.

Equipment.Name: Angel's Blessing
Equipment.Description: You'd think it keeps you alive rather than bringing you back. Yet, here we are.

Equipment.Name: Cycle Gem
Equipment.Description: Cycles through Fire, Ice, Wind, Earth, Thunder and Water, strengthening each while impeding all other elements.

Equipment.Name: Meditate Charm
Equipment.Description: Find inner peace.

Equipment.Name: Focus Charm
Equipment.Description: Seek inner strength.

Equipment.Name: Daredevil Boots
Equipment.Description: Time to play some Rocket Tag!

Equipment.Name: Dwarven Maul
Equipment.Comments: I'd like this to enable some Dervish memery. I doubt it will because nobody loves Dervish and Earth is actually kinda bad. But here we are.
Equipment.Description: Wait, this isn't from the other place...!

Equipment.Name: Phoenix Hero's Plate
Equipment.Description: Grants an inner flame that devours all evil.

Equipment.Name: Gemini
Equipment.Description: A pair of twins that batter, bruise and butcher. Stay clear if you value your life.

Equipment.Name: Coronacht
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Hades.
Equipment.Description: ...the so-called Heart-Seeker, is certainly the finest bow ever conceived...

Equipment.Name: Obsidian Staff
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Epic Battle Fantasy 5.
Equipment.Description: Made from shards of volcanic glass.

Equipment.Name: Epetam
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Etrian Odyssey IV.
Equipment.Description: A brutal, yet powerful dagger that can fly around in search of blood.

Equipment.Name: Claimh Solais
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow.
Equipment.Description: Sword with a sparkling blade.

Equipment.Name: Gradivus
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Fire Emblem Awakening. Description lifted from New Mystery of the Emblem because Awakening doesn't provide one.
Equipment.Description: A mighty lance, regalia of House Archanea.

Equipment.Name: Gaea Impact
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Disgaea 5... more or less.
Equipment.Description: Crush your enemies with the full mass of a Netherworld!

Equipment.Name: Day's Harvest
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Fell Seal: Arbiter's Mark. Why did they choose 62%...?
Equipment.Description: Yes, that's extremely specific. Don't ask me!

Equipment.Name: Brionac
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Persona 3 Portable. I recognise that 335 PAtk is *technically* too much, but unlike the others, it's still a reasonable value for CrysProj standards, so I couldn't help but keep it as-is.
Equipment.Description: A divine weapon that emits light.

Equipment.Name: Tome of Evocation
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Age of Wonders 4. That's not actually what Fulmination does, but nobody needs to know. Nobody... needs to know. Shhhh.
Equipment.Description: ...it follows that you can employ [magic] in a more devastating fashion in order to visit harm unto your foes.

Equipment.Name: Mask of the Timeless
Equipment.Comments: Adapted from Darkest Dungeon. Quote relates to the Bounty Hunter class as a whole, but the trinket in question lacks a description.
Equipment.Description: The thrill of the hunt... the promise of payment...

Equipment.Name: Bloody Murder
Equipment.Comments: Loosely adapted from Monsters' Den: Godfall.
Equipment.Description: Screaming is no defense.

Equipment.Name: Invisible Shield
Equipment.Comments: Inspired by Dungeons of Dredmor. (Not *adapted*, that game has like, *completely* different stats.)
Equipment.Description: No, really.

Equipment.Name: Happy Hour
Equipment.Description:
Last call, says our clock-- 
[Randomizer exclusive... for now]

Equipment.Name: Root of the Brute
Equipment.Description:
Here on my throne, sits a pretender (Traitorous! Not one of us!)
[Randomizer exclusive... for now]

Abilities.Name: Void of 30,000 Paces
Abilities.Description: May inflict Daze and Confusion. (35% chance, 2 turns)

Abilities.Name: Twilight Cut
Abilities.Description: Inflicts one of four debilitating debuffs at random.

Abilities.Name: Gunfire
Abilities.Description: Doesn't provoke Reactions. Cannot benefit from Armor Down.

Abilities.Name: Grey Depression
Abilities.Description: Applies a random status that purges an element from the target, rendering that element utterly ineffective for both sides.

Abilities.Name: Blaster Bash
Abilities.Description:
--Explosions served on the rocks!
(100% 1T Armor Down, 40% 3T Burn)

Abilities.Name: Stoneringer
Abilities.Description: Shift the wand's powers to function more like a spear.

Statuses.Name: Raging River Edge
Statuses.Description: Grants 30 Spi and Water element to physical attacks. On healing given, turns into Rising Jade Edge (+30 Str, Earth).

Statuses.Name: Rising Jade Edge
Statuses.Description: Grants 30 Str and Earth element to physical attacks. Turns into Raging River Edge (+30 Spi, Water, turns back on heal given).

Statuses.Name: White Judgment
Statuses.Description: -35% Mnd, +35% Spi. Turns into Black Judgment (+50% Mnd, -50% Spi) once enough healing has been done.

Statuses.Name: Black Judgment
Statuses.Description: +50% Mnd, -50% Spi. Turns into White Judgment (-35% Mnd, +35% Spi) once enough magical damage has been done.

Statuses.Name: Catastrophic Breach
Statuses.Description: Provides a massive boost to everything; kills and inflicts massive unremovable debuffs on expiry. Time is running out.

Statuses.Name: Fourth Trumpet
Statuses.Description: The fourth trumpet is blaring. All the rabbits have returned to the grassland.

Statuses.Name: Gripping Darkness
Statuses.Description: It could be fear, or a deep-seated craving...

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Fire
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Fire, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Ice

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Ice
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Ice, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Wind

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Wind
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Wind, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Earth

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Earth
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Earth, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Thunder

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Thunder
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Thunder, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Water

Statuses.Name: Power Shift Water
Statuses.Description: Strengthens Water, weakens all other elements. Next cycle: Fire

Statuses.Name: Fulmination
Statuses.Description: Standard attacks deal Thunder damage. Attack replacement: Zap. Counter all damage with Lightning.

Statuses.Name: Stabbening
Statuses.Description: With one sacrifice, I'll conquer my rivals.

Monsters.Name: Very Large Snail
Monsters.Comments: This thing isn't meant to be able to defeat you. It's just supposed to be a funny way of getting the Snail's Ring. If you're reading this and it managed to defeat you, please let me know ASAP.
